_source: Hand-verified during research: checked each state's own Secretary of State (or equivalent) site directly for a plain, static, address-free official ballot-measure document (a voter guide/pamphlet covering proposition text), not an API, not a lookup tool.
_method: Each entry here has a real, currently-or-recently-fetched document backing it and a registered parsing strategy in ballot_measures_pdf.py's STRATEGIES map. A state with no entry here still falls back to Vote Smart in election_pipeline._sync_ballot_measures — this file only ever ADDS coverage, it never removes a state's chance at data.

CA.description: Official Voter Information Guide, 'Quick Reference Guide' section. Verified against the real 2024 general (144 pages, 10 real propositions) and 2026 primary (64 pages, correctly zero propositions) guides. url_pattern's {year} is substituted at fetch time; the general-election path is the only one that carries propositions.
